_doc: A race layout's LAP (scripts/geometry/race_lap.py, ledger 0054 phase 2): race.laps.<id>.pieces stitched — each piece's source vertices VERBATIM, consecutive pieces bridged by points resampled on the straight join, closed (the last point repeats v0). Engine frame x=E, y=up, z=N, like centerline.local.json. source_by_vertex[k] = [line, vertex] (or ['join', j] into joins); every per-vertex race declaration of a layout on this lap keys on THESE vertices.
